assets.name: crane-quay.png
assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original chapter 8 Steel Dock background, one vertically scrolling portrait terrain tile for a top-down anime aircraft shooter, 1024x1536.
Reference image 1 is STYLE AND SCALE REFERENCE ONLY: its delicate gouache anime landscape brushwork, broad soft painted color groups, small white/petrol-blue facilities, naturally simplified forms and high aerial scale. Create entirely new industrial harbor scenery, not that coastal island.
Viewpoint: camera straight down or 85-88 degrees down, distant overhead aerial survey. Roofs dominate buildings, only extremely thin side faces; no close-up isometric cranes, no walls rising toward viewer. One complete coherent painted ground/water scene, opaque full bleed.
Theme: a believable sheltered steel shipyard and working harbor, low pale weathered concrete quays, petrol-blue steel frames, tiny ivory/blue-roof workshops, sparse muted orange cargo containers, restrained yellow safety stripes, dark teal sheltered water. Broad quiet painted brush strokes. Small simplified industrial fittings physically on their foundations; crane arms are slender and their shadows belong to the same dock.
Palette: gently lit off-white warm-gray concrete, subdued blue-gray roofs, cool teal water, muted rust-orange accents. Soft upper-right light, cool broad shadows; same value simplicity and painterly finish as reference. No ink outline, no shiny plastic, no hyperreal texture, no dense tiny greebles.
Composition: asymmetrical harbor piers in the outer 0-27% left and 76-100% right. Central half is largely open dark teal water for readable combat; docks may extend into side channels but no bridge spans the central gameplay lane. Land/water boundaries and short local service roads feel physically coherent. Small facilities typically 25-65px long on a 1024px-wide image, rather than large objects filling a third of frame. Occasional low grassy patches at land edges tie the scene to our hand-painted world. No clouds baked into terrain; cloud animation will be separate.
Scrolling constraints: top 130px and bottom 130px are ONLY quiet water across the entire width, with matching muted dark teal base color near #24546a. Structures/land fade out geographically before those end margins, not blurred. Top and bottom may have very low contrast broad water strokes, no foam or light streak crossing an edge. No gradient border, no poster framing.
Avoid aircraft, player/enemies, UI, labels, logos, text, watermark, giant ships, warships, explosions, unnatural floating structures, neon lights, fog blanket, black void, mirrored corridor walls or long perspective roads.

Layout variant A: left middle a gently stepped broad quay with a tiny dark-blue lattice crane, two blue-roof workshops and 6 loosely spaced containers. Its crane arm points diagonally along the edge of the quay rather than reaching the center. A narrow service road and low fuel shed connect them. Right upper-middle a smaller pier with a low utility block and a little mooring basin. Thin water wakes only at quay contact, no strong waves. Keep all objects tiny, grounded and painted.
